title: Arts center is hosting game show
text:
The Jamestown Arts Center will present a free game show– style production that features artists from the “Next” exhibition at 4 p.m. Sunday, May 17.
“The ‘Next’ Contestant” will be an experimental show style that is part panel discussion, part improv, with buzzers and games added to the conventional artist talk.
The 90-minute event, with JAC instructor Jon Baylor serving as the game show host, will feature exhibiting artists Alexi Sarah Widoff, Teddy Trocki-Ryba, Cordelia Thomas, Casey Weibust and Sarah Hirsch. Through a format that is both playful and incisive, the artists will pose questions to one another, generating an evolving dialogue around influence, artistic process and their shared connections to Jamestown.
In handing the artists the microphone, “The ‘Next’ Contestant” privileges lateral exchange over formal presentation. The conversation will unfold across practices, mediums and personal histories, spotlighting the relational and generational dynamics that shape the artwork. The program mirrors the ethos of the “Next” exhibition itself,
“Next” features artists ages 19-39. Along with the Widoff, Trocki-Ryba, Weibust, Thomas and Hirsch, on display are Gabriella Andreozzi, Eliza Boyer, Kyle Canyon, Alex Carlisle, Michela Colognese, Genevieve Dupre, Caia Diepenbrock, Ella Hutchinson, Jenny Lathan, Ailsa Petrie and Islay Petrie.
